in_sanskrit.name: Magan
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Moon God
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Magan एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Magan is a Sanskrit name derived from the word ‘Mandagini’, which refers to the moon. The moon is considered a divine and powerful symbol in Hindu mythology, representing the cycle of life and the passage of time. The name Magan is believed to bring blessings of prosperity, wisdom, and protection.
